# ApiPay Documentation

> ApiPay is a Vietnamese bank-transfer payment gateway API. This documentation covers integration, API reference, and guides.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/index): Integrate ApiPay into your system
- [Quick Start](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/quickstart): Create your first payment link and receive a webhook with ApiPay
- [Onboarding](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/onboarding): Complete guide to getting started with ApiPay
- [Subscription & Billing](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/subscription): Manage your ApiPay subscription and billing

## Banking & Payments

- [Bank Accounts](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/banking): Connect and manage your Vietnamese bank accounts to receive payments via ApiPay
- [Sandbox & Live Test](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/sandbox): Test payments and webhooks without real money
- [Dashboard Guide](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/dashboard): Navigate and use your ApiPay dashboard effectively
- [Connect Banks](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/connect-banks): Link your Vietnamese bank account to start receiving payments via ApiPay
- [ApiPay Connect](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/connect): Let your customers link their own receiving bank accounts with a one-time link, no tech team needed
- [Stores and Staff](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/stores-staff): Group your receiving accounts by store and give each team member access to only the payments they handle
- [Payment Speaker](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/payment-speaker): Turn any phone, tablet, or computer into a real-time bank transfer voice announcement speaker for free
- [Commerce](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/commerce): Create a product, copy a reusable payment link, collect buyer details, and email a receipt.
- [Custom Domains](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/custom-domains): Use your own domain for the ApiPay payment page
- [Passkeys](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/passkeys): Sign in to ApiPay faster with Face ID, fingerprint, or a device passkey
- [Affiliates](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/affiliates): Share ApiPay, track referrals, and manage commissions from the dashboard

## Integrations

- [Web App](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/integrations/webapp): Integrate ApiPay into your web app with JavaScript, Python, or PHP.
- [WooCommerce](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/integrations/woocommerce): Install the ApiPay payment plugin for WooCommerce.
- [Vibe Code](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/integrations/vibe-code): Generate an ApiPay integration prompt for AI coding assistants.
- [MCP Server](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/integrations/mcp): Connect ApiPay to AI assistants with the @apipay.vn/mcp MCP server.
- [WHMCS](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/integrations/whmcs): Install the ApiPay payment module for WHMCS.
- [HostBill](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/integrations/hostbill): Install the ApiPay payment module for HostBill.

## API Reference

- [Authentication](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/api/authentication): How to authenticate requests to the ApiPay API
- [Payment Requests](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/api/payment-requests): Create and manage payment requests
- [Commerce](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/api/commerce): Products, prices, reusable payment links, customers and receipts
- [Webhooks](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/api/webhooks): Receive payment notifications by webhook
- [Banks](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/api/banks): API for connecting and managing bank accounts
- [Metrics](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/api/metrics): Look up transactions and summary figures

## Interactive API Reference

- [API Reference](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/api-reference): Interactive API documentation with try-it console
